column1: # Shared case table for client credential resolution (issue #43).
# The SDK (ClientConfigResolverTest), the CLI (AuthConfigResolutionTest), and the Spark connector
# (CredentialResolutionConformanceTest) each load this file and check that the same inputs resolve to the same
# credential through their own entry points:
#   - file: client.properties (CLI, SDK ConfigSource.file) or server.auth.* catalog options (Spark)
# Columns are tab-separated. A value is either "-" (not set) or a double-quoted string, which may
# be empty or contain spaces. "missing" is the relative key reported as required, or "-" when the
# resolution succeeds. expected_username and expected_password are both "-" when no credential
